column1: # Pokémon Scarlet 4.0.0 (dump metadata v1), Game Freak Trinity, SDK 13.3.13, NVN.
# Experimental Android bring-up on RedMagic NX809J / Adreno 840 (2026-11-06).
# Shader tables come from this build's own main and Trinity packs, not Violet's.
# The supplied dump reported v1; a normal 4.0.0 update dump is v786432 (NACP 4.0.0, the same main build), so the rows name v786432.
# The host supplies the movie API; main takes nothing else from subsdk0.
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource. nninitStartup reserves a 12 GB
# StandardAllocator region; 4.375 GB and 12.375 GB alias regions both refused
# it (0x1803). The survey layout plus 24 GB of virtual headroom boots without
# allocator/SDK binary cuts; the log places that region's end at alias +13 GB.
# The allocator setup (main+0x167d510) allocates and frees all the 12 GB StandardAllocator can give, and the SDK keeps those pages mapped. Without the pool enforced, GetInfo's used
# memory left them out and the allocators' free sizes counted them twice (6.04 GB allocatable at setup, 4.33 GB free at frame 9000): the free-memory sample the game takes every 9000
# frames (main+0x2b7ab34) came out above its heap total, wrapped to 0, and the wild Pokémon spawner (Lua UpdatePokemon: despawn under 100 MB free) removed every wild Pokémon for good
# 35,937 shaders, including BNSH inside Oodle-compressed arc/data.trpfs entries.
